hdmi_link_evidence.method: Read-only I2C reads of the TV's SCDC registers (address 0x54 on the HDMI DDC bus, /dev/i2c-13) during playback; character error counters at 0x50-0x55 clear on read, sampled every 3 s. TV: LG (EDID GSM, 2024), HF-VSDB 600 MHz, SCDC present.
hdmi_link_evidence.status_flags: clock detected; channel-lock bits flapping (0x41/0x49 at 4K, 0x43/0x4b/0x4f at 1080p)

other_trials_on_4k_hdr_film.hvs_output_fifo: never empty mid-frame in 612,196 status samples over 12 s

hdmi_link_evidence.conclusion: RETRACTED as proof. After a cable and TV-port swap the counters were as high or higher, they were equally high while paused and on a visibly clean 1080p24 picture (ch1 about 20,000-32,000 per 3 s), so on this TV they do not track the visible fault.
hdmi_link_evidence.user_report: 4K HDR film flickered more strongly than the SD film and showed many green specks; TV reported 4K without HDR (the player sends 8-bit RGB with no HDR metadata).
